BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: B.TECH.   SEMESTER: V
BRANCH: ECE & EEE   SESSION: MO/2022

SUBJECT: CS276 CYBER LAW AND SECURITY

TIME: 2 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
5. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



    CO BL
Q1 (a) “Like citizens, netizens have certain rights and duties.” Comment. Explain who
are netizens.
[2] 3 2
Q1 (b) Explain the various threats to Network Security? Differentiate between Active
and Passive threats.
[3] 3 4


Q2 (a) What is cyberspace? Explain some of its features. [2] 1 2
Q2 (b) What is cyber law? Explain its component. [3] 1 2


Q3 (a) Write a detailed note and analyze some of the key issues addressed by IT Act,
2000.
[2] 2 4
Q3 (b) Many  people  have  the  opinion  that  “The  right  to  Internet  access,  must  be  a
fundamental  human right  so  that  they  can exercise and  enjoy their  rights to
freedom  of  expression  and  opinion  and  other  fundamental  human  rights  “–
evaluate and justify.
[3] 2 5


Q4 (a) Briefly explain the National and International law(s) regarding Online freedom of
speech and expression.
[2] 2 2
Q4 (b) Discuss the Right to Privacy in the Online environment and mention some of the
efforts and laws made by India and International community.
[3] 2 3


Q5 (a) Discuss some of the legal issues faced in electronic commerce environment.  [2] 3 3
Q5 (b) Define the term 'cybercrime'. Classify and differentiate between different types
of cybercrimes.
[3] 4 4
